name: Drew Dober
summary: A veteran southpaw lightweight (29-15, 1 NC) and the division's knockout leader with 11 (Cageside). He has won two straight by stoppage: Kyle Prepolec in R3 (October 2025) and Michael Johnson with a left hand in R2 (March 2026). Before that he lost three of four, two by knockout. Our data lists him at 38.

how_they_fight.Striking: Southpaw power puncher: about 4.5 significant strikes a minute at 44%, absorbing 4.3, with 0.65 knockdowns per 15. Seventeen KO/TKO wins. He works the body: he finished Rafael Alves with a liver shot in R3 at UFC 277 after Terence Crawford told him from ringside to go to the body (Sherdog).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Rarely shoots (about 0.5 takedowns per 15 at 23%). Five submission wins, the last in 2014.
how_they_fight.Defense: Hittable: Matt Frevola (R1, 2023), Jean Silva (R3, 2024) and Manuel Torres (R1, 2025) all stopped him. Grapplers beat him on the mat: Islam Makhachev (R3) and Beneil Dariush (R2) submitted him, and Renato Moicano held him down for over ten minutes in our data. Takedown defense is about 63%.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Dangerous in every round: of his 17 KO/TKO wins, six came in R1, seven in R2 and four in R3; his five submissions came in R1 (four) and R2 (one). Seven wins are decisions. Losses: seven decisions, four KO/TKOs (three in R1, one in R3) and four submissions (R1, R2 twice, R3).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced and adaptable mid-fight (the Alves body attack). Said he was nervous about Johnson's power and had his 'hands full' (Cageside).

patterns: Southpaw left hand and body shots
Out-wrestled and submitted by high-level grapplers
keys_to_beat: Take him down and attack the neck; grapplers have beaten him
Don't trade with his left hand at range

news.text: Explained how Terence Crawford's advice to go to the body helped him finish Rafael Alves; booked against Chris Duncan.
Betting on his UFC 326 fight with Michael Johnson was halted over unusual odds movement; Dober said he doesn't follow betting and the UFC had not contacted him. He knocked Johnson out in R2.
